ensure-cf-project.command: npx wrangler pages project list 2>&1 | grep -qw staging-todo || npx wrangler pages project create staging-todo --production-branch main

deploy.command: npx wrangler pages deploy dist/apps/ui/todo --project-name staging-todo --branch main

manual-deploy.command: npx wrangler pages deploy dist/apps/ui/todo --project-name staging-todo --branch main

ensure-cf-project:production.command: npx wrangler pages project list 2>&1 | grep -qw production-todo || npx wrangler pages project create production-todo --production-branch production

deploy:production.command: npx wrangler pages deploy dist/apps/ui/todo --project-name production-todo --branch production

ensure-cf-project:preview.command: npx wrangler pages project list 2>&1 | grep -qw preview-todo || npx wrangler pages project create preview-todo --production-branch main

deploy:preview.command: npx wrangler pages deploy dist/apps/ui/todo --project-name preview-todo --branch "$PREVIEW_BRANCH" --commit-hash "${PREVIEW_COMMIT:-$(git rev-parse HEAD)}"
